title: The night walk
goals: Reach the stair down to the dormitory.
Do not let Dask see you.
starting_code: # Dark, a locked door, a stair that comes and goes, and Dask on his round.
hints: One trouble at a time: the dark, the key and its door, the stair, then Dask.
Wait for the stair in one `while`, and for Dask in another.
Dask walks the lower corridor. Cross it while his back is turned: while he faces right, wait.
intro: So. You have come this far. One last walk through my passages tonight, in the dark, and past me.
outro: Well, well, {wizard}. Nobody has slipped past me in years. Go on to bed. And not a word to the others.
